mechanism_narrative: Higher residential fixed investment (RSAFS) signals robust housing sector activity, which correlates with strong consumer spending and corporate earnings growth, driving positive S&P 500 returns over the next 20 trading days.
failure_condition: SPX 20d returns are negative in more than 55% of periods when RSAFS exceeds its 12-month moving average.

mechanism_narrative: A federal funds rate above 4.5% signals an active monetary tightening cycle, which increases discount rates for equity valuations and suppresses risk appetite, leading to negative S&P 500 returns over the next 20 trading days.
evidence_refs: fact:Federal funds rate at 4.94% as of May 2006
failure_condition: When FEDFUNDS > 4.5%, SPX 20d returns are positive in more than 55% of cases.

mechanism_narrative: Simultaneous growth in employment (PAYEMS) and decline in unemployment (UNRATE) indicates a tightening labor market, which boosts consumer spending and corporate profits, driving positive S&P 500 returns over the next 20 trading days.
failure_condition: The joint signal (PAYEMS increasing and UNRATE decreasing) fails to produce positive 20d returns in more than 55% of instances.

mechanism_narrative: In late-cycle expansions, a decline in industrial production (INDPRO) relative to its 6-month average signals an impending slowdown in manufacturing output, leading to negative S&P 500 returns over the next 20 trading days.
failure_condition: In late-cycle expansions, a decline in INDPRO does not lead to negative 20d returns in more than 55% of cases.

mechanism_narrative: Elevated inflation (CPIAUCSL above 200.0) indicates persistent price pressures, which often triggers central bank tightening and reduces equity valuations, producing negative S&P 500 returns over the next 20 trading days.
failure_condition: SPX 20d returns are positive in more than 55% of periods when CPIAUCSL exceeds 200.0.

mechanism_narrative: Housing starts below 1800 thousand units indicate weak residential construction activity, which correlates with reduced consumer confidence and lower economic growth, leading to negative S&P 500 returns over the next 20 trading days.
failure_condition: When HOUST < 1800.0, SPX 20d returns are positive in more than 55% of cases.

mechanism_narrative: Concurrent declines in housing starts (HOUST) and residential fixed investment (RSAFS) signal a broad-based contraction in the housing sector, which reduces household wealth and consumer spending, driving negative S&P 500 returns over the next 20 trading days.
failure_condition: The joint signal (HOUST down and RSAFS down) fails to produce negative 20d returns in more than 55% of instances.

mechanism_narrative: In high-unemployment regimes (UNRATE > 5.5%), a decline in unemployment rate signals the start of a labor market recovery, which often precedes economic stimulus and positive equity returns over the next 60 trading days.
failure_condition: In high-unemployment regimes (UNRATE > 5.5%), SPX 60d returns are negative in more than 55% of cases.
